published_page_drift: The pinned cmark-gfm test/spec.txt is byte-identical to its 0.29.0.gfm.13 version but is not current with the published page.
Published Strikethrough Example 491 includes ~there~ and the page has Example 493; test/spec.txt has only examples 491 and 492.
The page includes additional cases before its Disallowed Raw HTML Example 657; test/spec.txt numbers the corresponding case 652.
extraction: Published HTML examples are extracted from paired pre/code.language-markdown and pre/code.language-html nodes, with HTMLParser entity decoding and space marker spans converted to literal spaces. Markdown is never reverse-derived from expected HTML. Pinned spec_tests.py convention maps U+2192 to a tab on both Markdown and expected HTML in the source corpora.
